hook.name: UniHooks Shared Hook
hook.description: A shared Uniswap v4 hook where each pool creator configures per-pool launch rules (anti-snipe, burn, LP rewards, treasury fee, sell tax, sandwich guard, allowlist, etc.). Takes a fixed 0.20% platform fee on every swap in the paired token; exact-output swaps are blocked when fee rules are active. Pool rules are immutable after creation.
